verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents agent construction, tools, model support, and CLI usage, but contains no mention of batch/bulk processing utilities, concurrency helpers for many items, or dataset-scale operations built into Pydantic AI. As a Python SDK, bulk processing could in principle be coded manually by looping over items, but no first-party feature or documentation specifically supports 'bulk operations across many items at once.' Missing for 10: any documented batch API, concurrent multi-item execution helper, or dataset-processing feature, plus independent evidence of such usage at scale.
